papers.title: Resilient Embodied AI for Smart Farming
papers.summary: Pest infestations remain a hazard for crop yields around the world, frequently going undetected until after irreversible damage has occurred. Existing pest detection systems and processes typically use fixed position sensors and/or human scouting and are slow to deploy, slow to respond, and poorly fit for dynamic environmental contexts. In this chapter, we present an embodied artificial intelligence (AI) approach that connects bioacoustic pest detection with mobile agro-robotic systems for pest detection and unique pest detection over large and complex agricultural areas in real time.
